parts.text:
To sign in to your Microsoft OneDrive account, you can use the official link below:

👉 **[Go to the OneDrive Login Page](https://onedrive.live.com/)**

### How to Log In:
1. Click the link above to open the OneDrive sign-in page.
2. Enter the **email address, phone number, or Skype ID** associated with your Microsoft account (or your work/school account).
3. Click **Next**.
4. Enter your **password** and click **Sign in**.

---

### Other Ways to Access OneDrive:
* **On Windows:** If you are using Windows 10 or 11, OneDrive is already built-in. Search for "OneDrive" in your Start menu, open the app, and sign in with your Microsoft account to sync your files directly to your computer.
* **On Mobile (Android/iOS):** Download the free **Microsoft OneDrive** app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store and sign in.
* **Work or School Accounts:** If you are logging in with an organization account, you can also sign in via the **[Microsoft 365 Portal](https://login.microsoftonline.com/)** and select the OneDrive icon from your app launcher.

*If you are having trouble logging in or forgot your password, click the **"Can't access your account?"** or **"Forgot password?"** link on the login page to reset it.*
